title: LogicSeg: Parsing Visual Semantics with Neural Logic Learning and Reasoning
mechanism: Class hierarchy and relations written as first-order logic rules, relaxed with fuzzy logic for training and applied at inference as matrix multiplications.
adaptation: Use the same tree as HSSN, plus the rules inactive -> defect, inactive region -> crack nearby, and padding excludes all others. This is a module on the existing U-Net++ logits.
min_experiment: Arm: house + LogicSeg rules. Baseline: house. Metrics: mIoU_rob, inactive precision. Kill if the mIoU_rob gain is < 0.01 and the inactive precision gain is < 0.03.
evidence: R: gains on four datasets with various models and backbones. The abstract page gives no numbers.

alt_notes.adaptation: Rules: inactive -> defect; inactive region -> crack nearby; padding excludes others. Only after the tree-loss or HSSN arm shows a gain.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm house + LogicSeg rule losses; baseline best tree arm; metric mIoU_rob and inactive precision; kill if gain < 0.01 over the tree arm.
